description: Request the single protected workflow required to execute the committed toolchain onboarding harness on a GitHub-hosted checkout when the assistant environment has no repository checkout or outbound GitHub DNS.
acceptance_criteria: A single workflow at .github/workflows/toolchain-onboarding.yml runs npm run toolchain:onboard on a GitHub-hosted checkout.
The workflow can be triggered by changes to dev_scripts/toolchain-onboarding-request.json and by workflow_dispatch.
The onboarding receipt is uploaded as a workflow artifact even when onboarding fails.
The workflow itself does not mutate repository source or bypass the onboarding harness fail-closed result.
non_goals: Grant the onboarding harness arbitrary mutation authority.
raw_operations_reason: This request intentionally targets exactly one protected .github/workflows path in order for Toolchain Orchestrator to surface the required CAPABILITY_GAP record before the user-authorized Infrastructure Publisher exception is used.

operations.content:
name: Frame Conn Toolchain Onboarding

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - dev_scripts/toolchain-onboarding-request.json

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: frame-conn-toolchain-onboarding
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  onboard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Run toolchain onboarding
        id: onboarding
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          FRAME_CONN_ONBOARDING_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/frame-conn-toolchain-onboarding-receipt.json
        run: npm run toolchain:onboard

      - name: Upload onboarding receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frame-conn-toolchain-onboarding-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/frame-conn-toolchain-onboarding-receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Enforce onboarding result
        if: steps.onboarding.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1
